stem:
Meera grows a chickpea (chana) seed in a pot at home. She notices that its seed splits into two halves when soaked. When the plant grows, she wants to predict its leaf venation and root system.

Which row correctly describes Meera's plant?

options.text: Monocotyledon, parallel venation, fibrous root system
Dicotyledon, parallel venation, fibrous root system

teacher.key_rationale: Chickpea (chana) seeds have two cotyledons, so the plant is a dicotyledon; dicots show reticulate venation and a taproot system, making C correct. D traps a student who drops the venation/root condition and reverses the link.
